(deftype ArrayChunk [arr off end]
  ICounted
  (-count [_] (- end off))

  IIndexed
  (-nth [coll i]
    (aget arr (+ off i)))
  (-nth [coll i not-found]
    (if (and (>= i 0) (< i (- end off)))
      (aget arr (+ off i))
      not-found))

  IChunk
  (-drop-first [coll]
    (if (== off end)
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "-drop-first of empty chunk"))
      (ArrayChunk. arr (inc off) end)))

  IReduce
  (-reduce [coll f]
    (ci-reduce coll f))
  (-reduce [coll f start]
    (ci-reduce coll f start)))
rationale: Retain complete pinned vector chunk sequence declarations and methods required by observable metadata-bearing vector equality. Defn bootstrap preserves every signature/body; typed Error adapter preserves errors. ES6/printing/public APIs and full collection acceptance remain required separately. Use the logical chunk count and indexed offsets through ci-reduce, rather than reducing to the end of the backing array. JVM Clojure 1.12.6 ArrayChunk respects its end field; a focused apply regression retains a bad value beyond that end and verifies it is not consumed.
